title: Staff retreat recap:
headline: The whole Soles4Souls team came to Nashville for a staff retreat. Their job that morning: put new shoes on about 250 kids.
story: This is a recap with one angle, not a timeline. The angle: the whole company showed up to work the floor. Staff from all over the world fitted shoes on kids from Conexión Américas families at The Fairgrounds Nashville.

Three voices carry it: Jamie Ellis (VP Strategic Communications, 8 years in), Nicole Gabehart (travel manager, the 250 number) and Teresa Miller (VP Development, why a shoe matters). Everyone else is picture. Warm and hopeful, never somber.
do: Frame 1 is the girl on the red carpet with the staff high-fiving her (MVI_4349) and the hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Keep the three voices only: Jamie, Nicole, Teresa. Everyone else is B-roll.
Name supers at the first on-camera line of each speaker, earliest 0:03, small, lower left, 2 seconds.
Use the mirror and red-carpet moments. They are the joy in this room.
End on the high-five line (MVI_4372), then the end card.
dont: Do NOT walk the day in order (arrive, orientation, event, clean-up). One angle, not a timeline.
Do NOT open on a logo, a title card, a wide empty room or a fade from black.
Do NOT use the Conexión Américas volunteer group photo (MVI_4381) as the opener.
Do NOT use the Alex lines or the thank-you-to-supporters lines. Those belong to the other two Nashville cuts.
Do NOT caption “Souls for Souls”. It is Soles4Souls.
